data.long_meaning: The meaning of Orson is recorded in name-lists as “Little bear”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Orson expresses “Little bear”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Orson total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_hebrew.name: אורסון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew words ‘aur’ (mountain, strength) and ‘son’ (man). It means ‘strong, bear, mighty man’.

in_greek.name: Ορσον
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word ‘oros’ (mountain) and ‘son’ (man). It means ‘mountain man’.

in_latin.name: Orsonius
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word ‘orsus’ (mountain) and ‘ius’ (man). It means ‘mountain man’.
